attempts.text:
**The window opens on a long spine.** Columns 0 to 31, `eamB` to `yphG`, are carried by 90 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 4% of calls. The model names 95 to 99.8% of them, fewest at column 22, `mltF`, 95%.

**A variable stretch follows**, columns 32 to 43, carried by 82 to 90%, the most plastic stretch of the window.

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 97 against 91%, and hesitates less there, 0.18 against 0.36 bits. Its most hesitant column, 59, `timP`, is a spine column, at 1.03 bits.

**The window ends in fork and variable columns.** Columns 71 to 79, carried by 44 to 90%, are named 82 to 90%. The last column is `pdeF`, in 44% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 95% of genes**, 0.23 bits on average, perplexity 1.3 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.79 against 0.16 bits, and names fewer genes, 75% against 98%.

label: eamB
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the eamB window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor eamB, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,129 to 1,208 from dnaA. Read in 534 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying eamB once); 42,720 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 95% of genes, 0.23 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 37,025 calls, named 99%, 0.15 bits; shell 5,262 calls, named 77%, 0.53 bits; cloud 433 calls, named 27%, 3.34 bits. Outside an RGP 37,648 calls, named 98%, 0.16 bits; inside an RGP 5,072 calls, named 75%, 0.79 bits. Columns: 58 spine, 7 fork, 15 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.79 against 0.16 bits) and names fewer genes (75% against 98%); 5,072 of the 42,720 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 59 (timP, a spine column) 1.03 bits, RGP 5%; column 31 (yphG, a spine column) 0.71 bits, RGP 4%; column 60 (sseA, a spine column) 0.66 bits, RGP 5%. The 6 columns (columns 38-43) where most calls are in an RGP: named 95%, 0.26 bits on average; the other 74 columns: named 95%, 0.23 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 58 spine columns: named 97%, 0.18 bits on average; the 22 fork and variable columns: named 91%, 0.36 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 59, is a spine column: the model can hesitate most inside a spine.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 32-43 (variable), RGP 5-87%; the least: columns 0-31 (spine), RGP 0-4%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-31 (32 columns) spine: share 90-100%, all P, RGP 0-4%. Genes: eamB, yfiE "LysR family transcriptional regulat…", srmB, trmN, nadB, rseD, rpoE, rseA, rseB "sigma-E factor regulatory protein R…", rseC, lepA "translation elongation factor 4", lepB, rnc, era, recO, pdxJ, acpS, shoB, yfhL "4Fe-4S dicluster ferredoxin YfhL", yfhH "MurR/RpiR family transcriptional re…", yfhb "phosphatidylglycerophosphatase C", tadA, mltF, purL, qseE "two component system sensor histidi…", qseG, glrR, glnB, hmpA, glyA, yphH "ROK family protein", yphG "DUF5107 domain-containing protein". named 95-99.8% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 22 (mltF), named 95%; most hesitant at column 31 (yphG), 0.71 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 32-43 (12 columns) variable: share 82-90%, 6 P, 6 S, RGP 5-87%. named 89-97% (mean 94%), fewest named at column 37, named 89%; most hesitant at column 32, 0.62 bits.
[S2.c32-43]    columns 32-43, share 82-90%, 6 P, 6 S: yphF "substrate-binding domain-containing…" 89%, yphE "sugar ABC transporter ATP-binding p…" 86%, yphD "ABC transporter permease" 90%, yphC "zinc-dependent alcohol dehydrogenas…" 90%, yphB "aldose 1-epimerase" 89%, yphA "DoxX family protein" 90%, hcaD 82%, hcaB 83%, hcaC "bifunctional 3-phenylpropionate/cin…" 83%, hcaF 83%, hcaE 82%, hcaR 83%
[S3] 3. columns 44-45 (2 columns) spine: share 92%, all P, RGP 5-12%. Genes: hcaT, csiE. named 96-97% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 45 (csiE), named 96%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.14 bits (column 45 (csiE)).
[S4] 4. column 46 variable: share 90%, all P, RGP 5%. named 95%; 0.24 bits.
[S4.c46]    46: yfhR P 90% "alpha/beta hydrolase"
[S5] 5. columns 47-70 (24 columns) spine: share 90-93%, all P, RGP 5-16%. Genes: suhB, trmJ, iscR, iscS, iscU "Fe-S cluster assembly scaffold IscU", iscA, hscB, hscA "Fe-S protein assembly chaperone HscA", fdx, iscX, pepB, sseB, timP, sseA, yfhM "alpha2-macroglobulin", pbpC, ndk, rlmN, rodZ, ispG, hisS, yfgM "ancillary SecYEG translocon subunit…", bamB, der. named 90-97% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 65 (rodZ), named 90%; most hesitant at column 59 (timP), 1.03 bits.
[S6] 6. columns 71-79 (9 columns) fork and variable columns: share 44-90%, 8 P, 1 S, RGP 13-19%. named 82-90% (mean 87%), fewest named at column 75, named 82%; most hesitant at column 76, 0.66 bits.
[S6.b71]    a second branch of 4 families through columns 71-74, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 15-26%, all S; the branch's families: "zinc ribbon domain-containing protein", sinH, "SinI family autotransporter-associated…", "adhesion domain-containing protein"
[S6.c71]    71 fork: yfgJ S 64% "zinc ribbon domain-containing prote…"
[S6.c72]    72 fork: xseA P 90%
[S6.c73]    73 fork: guaB P 90%

[S6.c75]    75 fork: yfgI P 70% "DUF5384 family protein"; also "tyrosine-type recombinase/integrase" S 11%
[S6.c76]    76 variable: yfgH P 66% "glycine zipper 2TM domain-containin…"
[S6.c77]    77 variable: yfgG P 59% "YfgG family protein"
[S6.c78]    78 fork: "hypothetical protein" P 54%; also "IS1 family transposase" S 13%, ppk1 P 12%
[S6.c79]    79 fork: pdeF P 44%; also ppx P 20%
